author: mia
title: Summer cricket preview
dek: Scheduled article: future-dated, so the build leaves it out until its date.
body:
The Australian summer of cricket starts in earnest this month, with Test matches, the Big Bash League and women's internationals filling the calendar until February. Bookmakers are already pricing the season, and the number of markets on offer grows every year. Here is what to expect and how to keep the summer enjoyable.

The calendar

The summer is long and busy. Test cricket fills the late spring and early summer, the Big Bash League runs from December through January, and white-ball internationals follow. The Women's Big Bash League finishes before Christmas.

  • Test matches: five-day games with markets on the result, top run scorer and first-innings totals.
  • Big Bash League: fast, evening T20 matches with a wide range of player and over-by-over markets.
  • Women's internationals: growing coverage and more markets than in previous seasons.

Markets explained

Cricket betting goes well beyond picking a winner, and some markets are easy to misread.

MarketWhat it means
Match resultWin, lose or draw; Tests can be drawn, T20s rarely
Top batterHighest run scorer for a team in the first innings
Total runsOver or under a set figure for an innings
Method of dismissalHow a batter gets out: caught, bowled, LBW and others

Weather matters more in cricket than in most sports. Rain can shorten a match or force a draw, and each bookmaker's rules say what happens to bets when that occurs. Read those rules before backing long-term markets.

What is new this season

Several bookmakers, including Vantro, have added same-game multis to T20 matches, combining legs such as team runs, top batter and total sixes. As with football, the combined price is lower than the legs multiplied together, because outcomes in one match are linked. Our explainer on same-game multis covers how that works.

Live betting on cricket is popular because the game has natural breaks between overs, but remember that online in-play betting on sport is restricted in Australia. Check how your provider offers live markets before relying on them.

Keeping it a summer pastime

A summer of cricket means many weeks of matches, often in the evening. That is a long time for small bets to add up. Set a weekly deposit limit that covers the whole season, and check your monthly activity statement in January to see how the summer is tracking.

The takeaway

Enjoy the cricket first and the betting second. Learn how a market settles before you bet on it, keep same-game multis small, and set your limit before the first ball is bowled. Free support is available from Gambling Help Online on 1800 858 858.
